title: COO morning prep & follow-ups
content:
Date: 2026-03-13
Quick context: travel day yesterday, back on campus. Two exec syncs, one customer escalations call (postmortem follow-up), and a Dedicated contract close expected Friday.

Top 3 priorities (today/week):
1) Dedicated contract close — ensure billing+legal checklist completed. Confirm with Ben (finance) on revised SOW by EOD Thu.
   - Key risk: pricing cap clause still unapproved by legal. Action: ping "legal-quick" thread, escalate to Priya if no reply by 2pm.
2) SRE hiring slate — finalize interview loop for senior SRE (onsite next week). Prep interview packet and assign panel.
3) Product rollout gating for experiment X — validate fallback policy and canary thresholds with Product and Serving Runtime.

Meetings / prep notes:
- 09:00 Exec daily (15m): agenda: Dedicated contract status, SRE candidate shortlist, monthly GTM metrics. Bring: 2-slide summary of risk areas.
- 11:00 Customer Escalation (60m): participants: CS, Eng, Legal. Goal: agree communication plan and remediation timeline. Prep: timeline slide, incident timeline bullets, compensation options (3 tiers).
- 14:00 Engineering sync (30m): topic: canary rollout policy. Note: ask for latency SLO rollback trigger definition.
- 16:00 Portfolio review with Sales Ops (30m): confirm renewal cadence and ARR numbers.

Action items (quick checkboxes):
- [ ] Confirm SOW edits from Legal (due 2026-03-13, owner: Ben)
- [ ] Send final interview loop to Talent (owner: Maya, due 2026-03-15)
- [ ] Update canary thresholds doc (owner: Ria, due 2026-03-14)
- [ ] Draft customer email template (owner: CS lead, due 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Run budget impact calc for Dedicated pricing cap (owner: Finance, due 2026-03-14)

Follow-ups & handoffs:
- Ben (Finance): confirm billing terms. Slack ping at 10:30 if no response.
- Priya (Legal): approve clause or propose alternative text. Escalation: loop in Ajay if not confirmed by 14:00.
- Ria (Serving Runtime): validate fallback variant latency when using quantized model; need benchmark by tomorrow.
- CS Lead (Anika): prepare customer comms and compensation options; attach to JIRA-4521.

Notes to self (raw / shorthand):
- Avoid overpromising on timeline — lane with legal delays is likely.
- Bring up Dedicated pricing caps in exec only if legal provides alternatives.
- Revisit the SRE hiring rubric: add scoring on incident postmortem ownership.

Parking lot / later this week:
- Ops runbook rewrite (post-contract close)
- VPC deployment checklist review with infra (owner: Lee)
- Leadership offsite planning (June) — draft agenda items: reliability, cost optimization, hiring

Quick links & refs:
- Incident timeline (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/2026-03-10-customer-outage
- JIRA: JIRA-4521, JIRA-4602
- Slack threads: #customer-esc, #coo-ops
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/319

Two-minute reflections:
- Keep tone calm and solution-oriented in customer call. Avoid technical deep dive unless asked.
- Use exec sync to get alignment on escalation budget before promising credits.

End of day (EOD capture):
- EOD: quick tick of items completed and unresolved (copy to exec shared note).
